## Description

Provide a clear summary of the changes made or the new tool added to the `/tools/` directory.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New tool/calculator addition
- [ ] UI/UX layout improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the project's **Zero Dependency** rule (pure HTML/CSS/JS).
- [ ] The code is isolated cleanly inside its own directory under `/tools/`.
- [ ] My commit summary is under 50 characters, with detail in the extended description.
- [ ] I have tested the calculations for mathematical edge cases.
